entry.name: Gallade-H
entry.flavor: When trying to protect someone, it extends its elbows as if they were swords and fights savagely.
entry.flavorEs: Es capaz de percibir al instante cuando alguien está en un aprieto y corre raudo a su lado para prestarle ayuda.
entry.flavorZh: 能够敏锐地感知到 寻求帮助的感情， 并且火速赶去援助对方。

abilities.textEn: If this Pokemon flinches, its Speed is raised by 1 stage.
abilities.textEs: Cada vez que se amedrenta sube su Velocidad, debido a su voluntad inquebrantable.
abilities.detail: If this Pokemon flinches, its Speed is raised by 1 stage.
abilities.detailEs: Cada vez que este Pokémon se amedrenta, su Velocidad sube un nivel.
abilities.detailZh: 每当该宝可梦畏缩时，其速度提高1级。
abilities.detailPt: Sempre que este Pokémon hesita, sua Velocidade sobe um estágio.

abilities.textEn: This Pokemon's slicing moves have their power multiplied by 1.5.
abilities.detail: This Pokemon's slicing moves have their power multiplied by 1.5.
abilities.detailEs: Aumenta la potencia de todos los movimientos 'cortantes' en un 50%.
abilities.detailZh: 使所有「斩切」类招式的威力提升50%。
abilities.detailPt: Aumenta o poder de todos os movimentos 'cortantes' em 50%.

abilities.textEn: This Pokemon's Attack is raised by 1 stage after it is damaged by a Dark-type move.
abilities.textEs: Si le alcanza un movimiento de tipo Siniestro, aumenta el Ataque debido a su integridad.
abilities.detail: This Pokemon's Attack is raised by 1 stage after it is damaged by a Dark-type move.
abilities.detailEs: Siempre que un movimiento de tipo Siniestro golpea a este Pokémon, su Ataque sube un nivel. El movimiento no se anula de ninguna manera.
abilities.detailZh: 每当恶属性招式击中此宝可梦时，其攻击提升一个等级。该招式不会以任何方式被抵消。
abilities.detailPt: Sempre que um movimento do tipo Sombrio atinge este Pokémon, seu Ataque sobe um estágio. O movimento não é negado de forma alguma.
